in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم زري مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ز-ر-ي' والذي يعني الذهب أو تزيين الشيء بالذهب. يستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية كدلالة على الجمال والزينة. وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الزينة والتحلية.

in_urdu.name: زری

in_hindi.name: ज़री
in_hindi.long_meaning: ज़री नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल 'ز-ر-ي' से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है सोना या सोने से जड़ना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में सुंदरता और आभूषण के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: زری
in_pashto.long_meaning: زری نوم د عربي ريښې 'ز-ر-ي' څخه مشتق دی چې د سرو معنی لري یا د سرو زینت. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني کلتور کې د ښکلا او زينت د نښه په توګه کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Zari
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zari originates from the Arabic root 'ز-ر-ي' (z-r-y), meaning gold or to adorn with gold. This name is used in Islamic culture to signify beauty and ornamentation. Derivatives of this root appear in the Quran in contexts discussing adornment and embellishment. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures to denote splendor and preciousness.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zari holds a rich cultural significance, particularly in Persian and Islamic communities. Its roots can be traced back to the Persian word 'zar', which translates as 'gold'. The name embodies the notion of beauty, splendor, and opulence, bringing forth images of valuable treasure and precious metals. Given this association, it's not uncommon for those bearing the name Zari to be viewed with admiration, raising their cultural status and reputation.
data.spiritual_significance: For the spiritual interpretation of the name Zari, it's essential to understand that in Islamic traditions, gold symbolizes a multitude of spiritual attributes. It represents generosity, as it is a valuable resource that people often share willingly. It is also associated with the concept of 'barakah' or God's blessings, which seeks continuous bounty and happiness. This spiritual meaning is further underscored by numerous hadiths (sayings of Prophet Muhammad) that encourage people to pursue wealth and gold in pursuit of a righteous life. Therefore, the name Zari, with its spiritual underpinnings linked to gold, suggests an individual deeply connected to the prosperity of both this world and the next.
